description: This file defines a React context and hook for managing the project state within a digital audio workstation (DAW) frontend application. It includes state management for project properties, tracks, transport controls, and editor settings, along with functions for adding, removing, exporting, and updating project data. It interfaces with external services for project persistence and audio control.

methods.name: useProject()
methods.description: Custom React hook that exposes the project context to components.

methods.name: ProjectProvider({ children, audio })
methods.description: React component that provides project, transport, and editor state and functions to its children.

methods.name: addTrack
methods.description: Adds a new track (audio or MIDI) to the project.

methods.name: removeTrack
methods.description: Removes a track from the project by ID.

methods.name: addClip
methods.description: Adds a clip to a specified track.

methods.name: setBpm
methods.description: Sets the beats per minute for the project and syncs with the audio engine.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads project data from a file.

methods.name: exportAudio
methods.description: Exports the project audio as a WAV file.

methods.name: saveProject
methods.description: Saves the current project state remotely.

methods.name: loadProject
methods.description: Loads a project by ID from external storage.

methods.name: renameTrack(trackId, newName)
methods.description: Renames a track by ID, with input sanitization and autosave trigger.
